title: veronica gandhii
intro: Veronica gandhii, commonly known as the "Bird's Eye Chamomile" or "Indian Speedwell", is a medicinal plant native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Veronica gandhii include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-anxiety properties, making it a popular remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
